# Tokens

Every token of the system, a section per group: Surfaces — 3 tokens; Text — 4 tokens; Fills and status backgrounds — 12 tokens; Charts — 11 tokens; Palette ramps and brand — 114 tokens; Type styles, families, font files; Spacing — 12 tokens; Radius — 5 tokens; Shadow — 3 tokens; Size — 12 tokens; Z index — 9 tokens; Duration — 4 tokens; Easing — 2 tokens; Breakpoint — 5 tokens; Opacity — 3 tokens.

## Color · Surfaces

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the dark theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--surface-1, #2d2d2d);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="light" or "booth" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from that theme’s column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--surface-1, #ffffff);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #2d2d2d;
```

### Tokens (3)

| token | dark | light | booth | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--surface-1` | #2d2d2d | #ffffff | #0f0f0f | Panels, neutral cards, table body, drawer, dialog. |
| `--surface-2` | #373737 | #ecece8 | #1c1c1c | Raised parts inside a surface-1 panel: table header, hovered row, segmented-control track. |
| `--surface-3` | #414141 | #e1e1dc | #2a2a2a | Pressed/selected neutral fills, progress tracks, skeleton shimmer base. |

## Type

Set text in one of the styles below: write its values from the Styles and Families tables, or, on a page that links or inlines tokens.css, prefer its variable, where the Styles table’s CSS column gives one.

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a style’s values from the Styles and Families tables */
font: 700 2.5rem/1.1 "Sora", "Inter", system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.01em;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the variables, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
font: var(--text-display-xl); letter-spacing: -0.01em;
font-family: var(--font-display);   /* the family alone */
```

| style | CSS | size / line, italic, letter spacing | weight | family | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `display-xl` | `.display-xl`, `--text-display-xl` | 2.5rem / 1.1, letter-spacing -0.01em | 700 | `display` | Cover and launcher home title only. |
| `title-l` | `.title-l`, `--text-title-l` | 1.75rem / 1.2 | 700 | `display` | Page title (the bold half of the thin–bold title). One per page. |
| `title-m` | `.title-m`, `--text-title-m` | 1.375rem / 1.25 | 700 | `display` | Section headings inside a page; dialog titles. |
| `title-s` | `.title-s`, `--text-title-s` | 1.125rem / 1.3 | 700 | `display` | Card titles, drawer group titles, track title in detail views. |
| `title-lead` | `.title-lead`, `--text-title-lead` | 1em / 1.2 | 400 | `display` | The lead-in of a thin–bold title: same size as the title it precedes, weight 400, colour fg-3 (or mod-*-muted inside a tonal card). Ends with a colon. |
| `figure` | `.figure`, `--text-figure` | 2rem / 1.05 | 700 | `display` | Headline figures in figure tiles; tabular numerals. |
| `body-l` | `.body-l`, `--text-body-l` | 1.0625rem / 1.55 | 400 | `body` | Help text, empty-state explanations, onboarding. |
| `body` | `.body`, `--text-body` | 0.9375rem / 1.45 | 400 | `body` | Default UI and table text (15px, Elektronauts' size). |
| `body-strong` | `.body-strong`, `--text-body-strong` | 0.9375rem / 1.45 | 600 | `body` | Track titles in rows, button labels, link text. |
| `body-s` | `.body-s`, `--text-body-s` | 0.8125rem / 1.4 | 400 | `body` | Meta lines under titles, helper text under fields, toasts. |

### Font files

Fonts: `tokens.css` loads each font from its file, by path.

- **Design canvas:** copy `fonts/sora-latin-wght-normal.woff2`, `fonts/inter-latin-wght-normal.woff2`, `fonts/inter-latin-wght-italic.woff2` and `fonts/jetbrains-mono-latin-wght-normal.woff2` to the same paths under the canvas’s `project/ds/<folder>/` (`<folder>` is the folder you install this system under; `fonts/sora-latin-wght-normal.woff2` lands on `project/ds/<folder>/fonts/sora-latin-wght-normal.woff2`), in the same call that installs this system; the copy of `tokens.css` that each artboard links loads them from there. If the install’s reply leaves a font out, bring that font in as for any other page.
- **Slides deck:** for each family you use in the deck (`faces` holds at most the number of typefaces Slides’ `deck-files.md` gives), install its file with the system and name the path it lands on as that family’s `src` in `project/deck.json` `faces`, under the key in the Slides column. A deck takes a font as a file only under the rule in Slides’ `fonts.md` (no space or leading underscore in its path, for two): any other font, or one kept by id, is uploaded as `fonts.md` says.
- **Any other page:** one file per family is enough (below: the upright face nearest regular weight; bold and italic synthesize). Fetch it as the fetch column says (Artifact tool `read`, that id or path as `path`), upload it as an asset (`publish`, `file_path`, `asset:true`) and declare it with an `@font-face { font-family: "<family>"; src: url(<uploaded>) }` rule.

`tokens.css` carries the `@font-face` rules for a page that links it and names each family by the CSS variable below.

| family | file | fetch | CSS | Slides `faces` key |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Sora | `fonts/sora-latin-wght-normal.woff2` (weight 100 800) | `read` the file with `project/` in front | `var(--font-display)` | `sora` |
| Inter | `fonts/inter-latin-wght-normal.woff2` (weight 100 900) | `read` the file with `project/` in front | `var(--font-display)` | `inter` |
| JetBrains Mono | `fonts/jetbrains-mono-latin-wght-normal.woff2` (weight 100 800) | `read` the file with `project/` in front | `var(--font-data)` | `jetbrains-mono` |

Every face: `fonts/sora-latin-wght-normal.woff2` (Sora, 100 800), `fonts/inter-latin-wght-normal.woff2` (Inter, 100 900), `fonts/inter-latin-wght-italic.woff2` (Inter, 100 900, italic), `fonts/jetbrains-mono-latin-wght-normal.woff2` (JetBrains Mono, 100 800).

## Spacing

4px base. Use gap on flex/grid, never margins between siblings.

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below */
padding: 0px;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the token’s name, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
padding: var(--space-0);
```

### Tokens (12)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--space-0` | 0px | No gap. |
| `--space-0\.5` | 2px | Hairline nudges: energy segment gap, icon-to-badge. |
| `--space-1` | 4px | Tight: chip padding block, icon-to-label in dense rows. |
| `--space-2` | 8px | Default gap inside controls and between chips. |
| `--space-3` | 12px | Gap between form fields in a row; table cell inline padding. |
| `--space-4` | 16px | Card padding (compact), page side gutter minimum, gap between cards. |
| `--space-5` | 20px | Card padding (default). |
| `--space-6` | 24px | Gap between sections inside a page; drawer padding. |
| `--space-8` | 32px | Gap between page regions (rail and content). |
| `--space-10` | 40px | Space above a section heading. |
| `--space-12` | 48px | Page top padding below the header on wide screens. |
| `--space-16` | 64px | Cover and empty-state breathing room. |

Three-step shape scale: the rounder, the bigger and more 'object' it is.

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below (--radius-chip: 4px) */

```

### Tokens (5)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--radius-chip` | 4px | Chips, tags, pills with text, energy segments (2px inside bars), key badges. |

| `--radius-card` | 14px | Cards (tonal and neutral), launcher tiles, figure tiles, popovers. |
| `--radius-sheet` | 18px | Drawers' inner edge, dialogs, media viewer: the biggest objects. |
| `--radius-pill` | 999px | Status pills, the toggle switch, progress bars, avatars of services. |

## Shadow

Depth means 'floats above the page'. Cards rest at shadow-1; only floating layers get more.

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below (--shadow-1: 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.30) in the dark theme; the table gives its value in the others) */
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer var(--shadow-1), so that a change to tokens.css, or a change of theme, reaches the page */
```

### Tokens (3)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--shadow-1` | 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.30) · light: 0 1px 2px rgba(20, 20, 24, 0.08) · booth: none | Resting cards (Ghost style): barely there; the border does the work. |
| `--shadow-2` | 0 6px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45) · light: 0 6px 20px rgba(20, 20, 24, 0.14) · booth: 0 0 0 1px #a8a8a8 | Popovers, menus, tooltips, the sticky header once scrolled. |
| `--shadow-3` | 0 18px 48px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55) · light: 0 18px 48px rgba(20, 20, 24, 0.22) · booth: 0 0 0 2px #ffffff | Drawers and dialogs above the scrim. |
